headline_sentence: Cuba departures are paused for the whole winter 2026-27 season. Three sun destinations sit in the same price bracket from Montreal for a February week.

destinations.name: Dominican Republic
destinations.why: The closest match on price, and the same all-inclusive format Varadero travellers are used to.
destinations.option_line: **Dominican Republic** - from **$1,890 per person** - Puerto Plata, Samana or Punta Cana. Closest on price, same all-inclusive format, about 4h30 direct.

fr.name: République dominicaine
fr.why: L'équivalent le plus proche côté prix, avec la même formule tout-inclus que vous connaissez.

destinations.name: Pacific Mexico
destinations.regions: Puerto Vallarta, Los Cabos, Riviera Nayarit
destinations.why: Bigger resorts and more to do off-property, for about $150 more per person.
destinations.option_line: **Pacific Mexico** - from **$2,040 per person** - Puerto Vallarta or Los Cabos. Bigger resorts and more to do off-property, about 6h direct.

fr.name: Mexique — côte Pacifique
fr.regions: Puerto Vallarta, Los Cabos, Riviera Nayarit
fr.why: De plus grands complexes et plus à faire à l'extérieur, pour environ 150 $ de plus par personne.

destinations.name: Jamaica
destinations.why: The shortest flight of the three and the strongest beaches, at the top of the bracket.
destinations.option_line: **Jamaica** - from **$2,120 per person** - Montego Bay or Negril. Shortest flight of the three and the best beaches, at the top of the bracket.

fr.name: Jamaïque
fr.why: Le vol le plus court des trois et les plus belles plages, en haut de la fourchette.
